blocks.text: Student Learning Outcomes (is unit mein kya seekhenge)
Is unit ke aakhir tak aap yeh kar sakenge:

items: Computational problems (computer se hal hone wale masle) bata sakenge aur unki types (qismein) bana sakenge.
Masle hal karne mein algorithms (qadam ba qadam tareeqa) ki importance (ahmiyat) samjha sakenge.
Masle hal karne ke liye generate and test method (hal banao aur jaancho) istemal kar sakenge.
Solvable (hal hone wale) aur unsolvable (hal na hone wale) maslon mein farq bata sakenge.
Problem complexity (masle ki mushkil) samajh kar maslon ko P, NP, NP-Hard aur NP-Complete mein baant sakenge.
Aam computational problems pehchan sakenge, jaise sorting (tarteeb dena) aur searching (dhoondna).
Algorithm design ke tareeqe istemal kar sakenge, jaise divide and conquer (tod kar hal karna), greedy methods aur dynamic programming.
Bubble Sort, Binary Search, BFS aur DFS jaise algorithms bana kar unka comparison (muqabla) kar sakenge.
Algorithms ko efficiency (kam waqt aur kam jagah) aur scalability (bade data par bhi chalna) ki base par check kar sakenge.
Algorithmic thinking (qadam ba qadam sochna) se maslon ko systematically (tarteeb se) hal kar sakenge.

blocks.text: Is chapter mein hum dekhenge ke algorithms ki madad se problems (masle) kaise hal kiye jate hain. Algorithm kisi kaam ko karne ki step-by-step (qadam ba qadam) instructions (hidayat) hain. Algorithms samajhna sirf computer science ke liye nahi, rozmarra ke masle hal karne ke liye bhi zaroori hai. Pehle hum seekhenge ke computational problem kya hota hai aur use saaf saaf kaise bayan karte hain. Phir alag alag qism ke algorithms dekhenge aur yeh ke woh kis tarah ke masle hal karne mein madad dete hain. Hum yeh bhi dekhenge ke algorithm ki efficiency (yani kitne kam waqt aur memory mein kaam hota hai) kaise naapi jati hai taake behtareen hal mil sake. Chapter ke aakhir tak aap systematic (tarteeb se, qadam ba qadam) tareeqe se soch kar algorithms ke zariye achhe hal bana sakenge.

Computational problem aisa masla hai jo computational process se hal ho sakta hai, yani algorithm ke zariye. Algorithm qadam ba qadam instructions ka set hai jise computer chala (execute kar) sakta hai. Maqsad yeh hai ke qadmon ke ek finite (khatam hone wale) sequence (lari) par chal kar hal tak pohncha jaye, aur yeh qadam computer kar sakta ho.

items: Input: Masla ek input se shuru hota hai, yani woh data ya maloomat jo algorithm ko di jati hai.
Output: Woh hal ya nateeja jo algorithm input par kaam karne ke baad deta hai.
Process: Woh qadam ya rules (yani algorithm) jo input par lagaye jate hain taake output bane.

blocks.prompt: Do numbers mein se bara number dhoondne ke masle ka input, process aur output bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Input: do numbers. Process: dono ka comparison karna. Output: un mein se bara number.

items: Computational problem algorithm se hal hota hai: input se process ke zariye output tak qadmon ka finite sequence.
